title: Ing Metung a E Kayabe ning Pamanyubuk ning Danum
intro: keng annals ning minunang kasulatan, atin yang metung a makabaldugan a tau na ing istorya na magumpisa ya ali keng metung a dramatic a milagro o metung a makaduldul a kapahayagan, nune keng metung a simple pero malalam a pamagsubuk keng kasalpantayanan. Ing metung a bangsa makatalakad ya keng krusada, manintun yang banal a patnube para keng pamanimuna. Ing milyari metung yang pamagsubuk a sobrang katalinuhan a pepakit na ing tune talasalpantaya karela. Malyari meng abalu ing misteryung ini ibat kareng clues a likuan mu?
clues: Ibat ku keng metung a lahi a pagmaragul da reng tau, at pinili na ku ning Allah para keng sagradung sangkan a e ra aintindian.
Ing katawan ku atin yang marka ning pamiyaliwa na ala kareng aliwa, inya makatalakad kung makabukud kareng tau ku.
Inyang ing ilug mipabalu yang test, keraklan mibalik la—pero aku migpursigi ku, a tinulak ning alang patugut a kasalpantayanan king pangaku nang Allah.
Inutus da kanaku ing e ku minum king bawal a danum, oneng metung a patak ing tinakas karing labi ku—metung a kasalanan a menabu king pusu ku kapilan man.
Ing Allah tinggap na kung akit ing metung a kayanakan a pastul na metung a aldo maging legendary ya keng pamakamate na keng metung a kalaban.
Inyang mipaglaban la ding sundalus, menabu ku e king gamat ning kalaban, nune king kautusan ning banal bilang parusa king kanakung e kapamintuan king ilug.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
